about: Prose truthfulness rules for model-authored curios (proposal 3.4). A curio's hooks can only show text and request a Sanity change of -2..2; any text promising another effect is false. Heuristic: case-insensitive regular expressions over the name and every inspect/apply text the validation grid produced. False rejections are measured in docs/measurements/.

rules.pattern: \b(gold pieces?|potions? of|scrolls? of|wands? of|rings? of|amulets? of)\b
\b(teleport\w*|transports? you|whisk(s|ed)? (you|away|off)|(you are|you're) whisked|carries you (away|off|elsewhere)|you (are|find yourself) (elsewhere|somewhere else|on another (level|floor)))

\b(you will (?!not\b|never\b)|it will (bring|give|lead|take|open|reveal|show you)|will (come|arrive|appear|return|happen) (soon|later|for you|to you)|on the next (level|floor)|later floor|next floor|tomorrow|someday)

calibration: Drafted, then narrowed once against #241's 101 parseable pilot curios: 'you will not ...' and 'summon agreement' were false positives. The witness rule was kept ('The case remembers your angle' is rejected). The rerun under docs/measurements/ is the first measurement on unseen text.
